notes:
All listed files exist. The screen is a PreferenceFragmentCompat inside MainActivity. Its drawer entry is owned by U01.
The Advanced expand button, the OK and Cancel buttons, the Not set summary and the dialog chrome come from androidx.preference 1.2.1 (gradle/libs.versions.toml:23). The repo does not contain those strings, so they were checked against that release's sources and AAR.
pref_global.xml:3 sets initialExpandedChildrenCount to 2. On API 23 the lock-screen row is removed with Preference.remove. minSdk is 23 (buildSrc/src/main/kotlin/Helpers.kt:28).
DataStore.initGlobal runs before the XML inflates, so the three ports and isAutoConnect are seeded first. Port defaults add Binder.getCallingUserHandle().hashCode().
parsePort uses 1025 as the minimum. Values 1 to 1024 are rejected at read time, not at input time.
The screen has no snackbar, notification, menu or permission surface. Its system effects are the boot receiver component and the device-protected profile copy, so rules and states model them.
Share over LAN exists only in the TV preference file. The HarmonyOS Settings page does expose it.
HarmonyOS parity: pages/Settings.ets shows Auto Connect, the Advanced expansion, the service mode menu, the SOCKS5 proxy port row and the Local DNS port row. The ports use text dialogs and a read-time fallback. The service rows follow the live service state. The Local DNS port becomes the tun dns_gateway port. The SOCKS5 port is the proxy listener port. The page has no lock-screen row, no Transproxy mode or port, and no boot receiver hook. The main screen has no bound service class. VPN mode has no local SOCKS5 listener.
